verses.text:
In God alone my soul finds rest;

my salvation comes from Him.

How long will you threaten a man?

Will all of you throw him down

like a leaning wall

or a tottering fence?

Rest in God alone, O my soul,

for my hope comes from Him.

He alone is my rock and my salvation;

He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.

My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock;

my refuge is in God.

Trust in Him at all times, O people;

pour out your hearts before Him.

God is our refuge.

Selah

Lowborn men are but a vapor,

the exalted but a lie.

Weighed on the scale, they go up;

together they are but a vapor.

Place no trust in extortion,

or false hope in stolen goods.

If your riches increase,

do not set your heart upon them.

and loving devotion to You, O Lord.

For You will repay each man

according to his deeds.

text: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him. He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken. How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence? They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him. He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken. My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God. Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor. Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them. God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God, and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
